item.title: Unable to overcome second quarter lapse, West Chester falls to Millersville
item.description: Trailing by 20 at the half, the Golden Rams battled back the rest of the way, but the damage was done. The end result was a 73-59 setback that dropped WCU from a fifth place tie into sixth in the PSAC East with seven regular season games to be played.

item.title: Comeback falls short; West Chester loses at home to Millersville
item.description: The Golden Rams found a way to overcome a shaky first half and battled down to the wire before falling to Millersville, 82-75. West Chester still has a one-game lead in the division standings at 10-4 (16-5 overall), but at 9-5, both East Stroudsburg and Millersville (14-7 overall) are nipping at the Rams’ heels with seven games remaining in the regular season.

item.title: Dominick Barlow’s career night leads 76ers past Clippers for fourth straight win
item.description: Tyrese Maxey scored 29 points, and Dominick Barlow added 26 points and 16 rebounds as the 76ers beat the Los Angeles Clippers 128-113 on Monday for their fourth straight victory.
